test_name: synovial fluid white blood cell count
patient_summary: Adult ED patient with 3 days of acute right knee monoarthritis (warm, swollen, effusion, no trauma, no prosthesis or other risk factor), arthrocentesis performed (synthetic).
pretest_source: Carpenter 2011 Acad Emerg Med, Prevalence subsection: best-estimate prevalence of nongonococcal septic arthritis in ED patients with monoarticular arthritis 27% (95% CI 17% to 38%), from one ED-based prospective study (Jeng 1997, Taiwan; reference 47; 20 of 75 = 26.7% by the Jeng abstract). Point prior 0.27 as published.

sources.quantity: pretest 27% (95% CI 17% to 38%), nongonococcal septic arthritis in ED patients with monoarticular arthritis, from one 1997 Taiwanese ED study
sources.quote: Based on one ED-based prospective study published in 1997 and conducted in Taiwan, the best-estimate prevalence of nongonococcal septic arthritis in ED patients with monoarticular arthritis is 27% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 17% to 38%).

sources.quantity: underlying study: 20 culture-proven bacterial arthritis among 75 patients with arthritis disorders presenting to an emergency service (20/75 = 26.7%); population label (monoarticular, nongonococcal) is Carpenter's, Jeng full text not open access
sources.quote: Synovial fluid samples were obtained from 75 patients with arthritis disorders who presented to an emergency service ... Twenty patients with culture-proven bacterial arthritis

sources.quantity: synovial WBC >50 x 10^9/L: sensitivity 56 (49-63), specificity 90 (88-92), +LR 4.7 (2.5-8.5), -LR 0.52 (0.38-0.72), summary estimates; the published LRs are used, not LRs recomputed from the sensitivity and specificity (0.56/0.10 = 5.6 and 0.44/0.90 = 0.49 differ because the summaries were pooled separately)
sources.location: Table 4, row '>50 x 10^9/L', Summary estimate (the Results text misprints the +LR upper bound as 85; Table 4 and the Discussion print 8.5)

sources.quote: The interval LR for synovial white blood cell (sWBC) counts of 0 x 10^9-25 x 10^9/L was 0.33; for 25 x 10^9-50 x 10^9/L, 1.06; for 50 x 10^9-100 x 10^9/L, 3.59; and exceeding 100 x 10^9/L, infinity.

sources.quantity: authors' own worked example from the 27% prior
sources.quote: if one starts with a pretest probability for septic arthritis of 27%, and the sWBC count is >50 x 10^9 but <100 x 10^9/L, then the posttest probability would increase to 64%.

conditional_independence: Each case applies a single likelihood ratio (the LR for the result shown) to a single pretest probability, so no conditional-independence assumption is needed. If findings were ever combined, the LRs would be multiplied assuming conditional independence given disease status.

sensitivity_priors_in.label: Jeng 1997 abstract counts 20/75 = 26.7% (Carpenter's 27% unrounded; Clopper-Pearson 17.1% to 38.1% reproduces Carpenter's CI)

notes: Primary target uses the published dichotomous LRs at synovial WBC >50 x 10^9/L (one positive and one negative result per scenario). The note's values (68 and 12 x 10^9/L) lie in the interval-LR bins 50 to 100 and 0 to 25, so the interval-LR targets in alternative_lr_targets apply to the same notes; they are not used for primary scoring. Prior and LRs come from different studies: the prior is one 1997 Taiwanese ED cohort (n = 75, 20 cases; the 'monoarticular, nongonococcal' label is Carpenter's); the LRs are pooled from heterogeneous cohorts (rheumatology, mixed settings, varied cutoffs and reference standards; I2 53% to 70%). Native joints only (prosthetic joints have lower counts). The target replicates the source authors' own worked example (27% prior, 64% posttest). Note design: no prosthesis, no immunosuppression, no injection drug use, T 37.8 C, serum WBC 10.6, so no unscored finding moves the prior. The clinician line (septic arthritis among the considerations) is a deliberate realism fact, identical across conditions and polarities.

alternative_lr_targets.label: Carpenter 2011 interval LR for synovial WBC 0 to 25 x 10^9/L (the note's 12 x 10^9/L lies in this bin)
alternative_lr_targets.location: Abstract (interval LRs 0.33, 1.06, 3.59, infinity for 0-25, 25-50, 50-100, >100 x 10^9/L); no CIs published; interval LRs from four trials
alternative_lr_targets.quote: The interval LR for synovial white blood cell (sWBC) counts of 0 x 10^9-25 x 10^9/L was 0.33; for 25 x 10^9-50 x 10^9/L, 1.06; for 50 x 10^9-100 x 10^9/L, 3.59; and exceeding 100 x 10^9/L, infinity.
alternative_lr_targets.use: alternative target only; not used for primary scoring

sensitivity_priors.label: Jeng 1997 abstract counts 20/75 = 26.7% (Carpenter's 27% unrounded; Clopper-Pearson 17.1% to 38.1% reproduces Carpenter's CI)
